properties.name: FCL-1 local causal learning law
properties.description: Outcome이 실제 canonical revision과 새로운 행동을 만드는가를 묻는 국소 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: Transcript persistence or prompt reuse alone does not satisfy causal learning.
acceptance_logic: sealed trajectory outcome admits an owner-valid canonical revision
matched removal and exact restore remove and recover the next-behavior effect

properties.name: FCL-2 composition preservation law
properties.description: 작은 HSWM들이 연결될 때 같은 동역학과 정체성이 보존되는가를 묻는 합성 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: A central wrapper or federation that erases member provenance is not preserved HSWM composition.
acceptance_logic: the composite again satisfies Step Learn Inv Permit and lineage
member identity provenance typed ports and exit survive regrouping

properties.name: FCL-3 emergent coalition law
properties.description: 고정 orchestration 없이 상황에 맞는 coalition과 hyperedge가 생기는가를 묻는 창발 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: No fixed orchestration does not remove invariants, permission, accountable coordination, budgets, or safe stopping.
acceptance_logic: input state and budget select and dissolve role-aware n-ary coalitions
matched fixed-route ablation does not reveal a hidden mandatory commander

properties.name: FCL-4 multiscale credit law
properties.description: 전체 결과를 구성 cell과 관계에 제대로 귀속할 수 있는가를 묻는 다중규모 credit 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: Global reward alone and post-hoc narrative attribution do not establish causal multiscale credit.
acceptance_logic: whole outcome credit is provenance-bound to cells relations hyperedges and scale transitions
actual credit changes the next route differently from uniform and shuffled controls

properties.name: FCL-5 topology morphogenesis law
properties.description: 경험에 따라 topology와 역할이 바뀌면서도 붕괴하지 않는가를 묻는 형태발생 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: Unbounded node growth, fixed topology, or lineage-breaking rewrites fail morphogenesis.
acceptance_logic: experience revises typed topology ports and roles under invariant and lineage checks
lesion growth and exact restore tests distinguish regeneration from uncontrolled drift

properties.name: FCL-6 world-self co-model law
properties.description: 외부 세계와 자기 내부 구조를 같은 graph에서 예측하고 수정하는가를 묻는 세계·자기모델 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: A static inventory or detached dashboard is a projection, not a causally active world-self model.
acceptance_logic: external events and internal composition boundary capability and uncertainty are typed in one canonical hypergraph
intervention prediction error revises subsequent prediction and routing

properties.name: FCL-7 diachronic continuity law
properties.description: 모델 호출과 세대가 바뀌어도 학습 계보와 주체성이 지속되는가를 묻는 장기 연속성 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: UID persistence or weight preservation alone does not establish continuing HSWM subjectivity.
acceptance_logic: checkpoint process and generation changes preserve identity-bearing invariants provenance learned dispositions and restore lineage
migration and fork merge retain explicit contributor ancestry

properties.name: FCL-8 HSWM-of-HSWMs law
properties.description: 개인·agent·조직·사회 규모까지 자기유사 합성이 확장되는가를 묻는 HSWM-of-HSWMs 법칙.
properties.claim_boundary: Federation, dashboard, message bus, KG publication, central aggregation, or social connectivity alone does not satisfy HSWM-of-HSWMs.
acceptance_logic: personal agent organizational and social composites re-expose the same causal-learning contract
